top_signals.title: Lula Plans $28 Billion Debt Buyout to Aid Consumers Before Vote
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s government plans to spend 15 billion reais to buy as much as 150 billion reais ($28 billion) of delinquent consumer debt from banks, part of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s push to ease the financial strain on households and bolster his bid for a fourth term.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: When tourists do the ‘Nagoya skip,’ do they know what they’re skipping?
top_signals.summary: Despite historical, cultural and culinary draws, only 10% of overseas visitors set foot in Aichi and Gifu prefectures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
